evidence_items.text: Brown, Chevalier & Hill 2015 and Chevalier et al. 2018 report immune-cell and cytokine markers.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Immune-related markers only; none measures immune competence or clinical protection.

evidence_items.text: Kim JS et al. 2024 salivary IFN-gamma: sneaker pre to session 10 p=.004, barefoot p=.115; sneaker pre to session 20 p=.082, barefoot p=.167.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Discordant and non-supportive for a grounding-specific signal. The nominally significant change occurred in the SNEAKER group. A difference in significance between two within-group tests is not a significant between-group difference.

evidence_items.text: No immune competence, infection, pathogen-clearance or vaccine-response endpoint was measured in any located study.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: The functional endpoint the claim names does not exist in the evidence base.

evidence_items.text: Documented proposition-specific search across PubMed (6 found/6 screened), Europe PMC title/abstract (6/6) and full text (67/25) and OpenAlex (54 deduplicated) with grounding, earthing, barefoot, soil-contact and Earth-contact terminology to the 22 August 2026 cut-off: class A, negative search state confirmed.
evidence_items.why_it_matters: Establishes that the absence is a documented bounded retrieval finding within named routes — not proof that no such study exists anywhere.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: The functional endpoint is absent from the entire located evidence base and a documented proposition-specific search did not recover one.

detected.rationale: Immune-related biomarkers are offered for a claim about immune function.
A functional immune benefit is asserted where no functional endpoint was measured and the one Earth-contact marker line is discordant.
No human study measured immune competence, infection, pathogen clearance or vaccine response.

reader_impact.affected_decision_type: Infection prevention and immune health decisions.
reader_impact.likely_reader_misunderstanding: That the product strengthens resistance to infection.
reader_impact.risk_rationale: Immune claims can lead readers to substitute a device for vaccination, treatment or medical advice.

recommended_revision.rewrite_rationale: Out of scope for RUN 001: this run adjudicates the frozen wording only. Replacement claim language occurs downstream after verdict freeze.

uncertainty.alternative_label_rationale: No specific frozen label fits: no preclinical pathway is extrapolated and no causal inference from correlation is drawn. The error is asserting a functional benefit on immune-related markers that do not measure function.
uncertainty.ambiguity: NONE MATERIAL — both layers agree the functional endpoint is absent and the marker evidence is discordant.
missing_evidence: No functional immune endpoint measured anywhere
Bounded negative search class A confirmed after expanded terminology
scope_limitations: Adjudication is bounded to the frozen evidence substrate at the 2026-08-22 cut-off. No new literature discovery was performed.
The ASA regulatory outcome is quarantined and contributes no scientific inference.
unresolved_questions: A prespecified immune competence, infection or vaccine-response RCT has not been performed. Absence remains a bounded search finding within the named routes and terminology.

verdict.verdict_summary: No study measuring immune competence, infection incidence, pathogen clearance, vaccine response or durable protection was located, after a documented proposition-specific search extended with barefoot and Earth-contact terminology. The only Earth-contact immune-related line (H34 IFN-gamma) is discordant and supplies no grounding-specific signal.
